title: Filling an Inverted Conical Tank
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Water pours into an inverted cone (height 10 m, base radius 4 m) at 2 m^3/min. How fast is the water level rising when the depth is 5 m?

steps.title: Use Similar Triangles to Relate Radius and Height
steps.explanation: The cross section of the conical water column forms similar triangles with the tank.
steps.why: Eliminates r to express volume solely in terms of depth h.

steps.title: Express Volume as a Single Variable Function of h
steps.explanation: Substitute r = (2/5)h into conical volume formula.
steps.why: Simplifies differentiation to a single independent variable.

steps.title: Substitute h = 5 m and dV/dt = 2 m^3/min
steps.explanation: Solve for the rate of rise dh/dt.
